_README: Repo -> simulation build/test recipe map, consumed by run_all.py --enable-sim.
Keyed by the case's fix_repo 'owner/name' (case-INSENSITIVE) and also by the
short repo id used in bench_150 (e.g. 'openhwgroup.ariane'). run_all resolves a
case to an entry by trying, in order: exact 'owner/name', lowercased 'owner/name',
the bench 'repo' short id, then '_default'. A per-case override may live in the
case .meta.json under key 'sim_target' (a string test target) or 'sim_recipe'
(a full object like the ones below); those win over this map.
Entry fields:
runnable   bool  - whether this repo can actually build+sim in the CI image.
When false, run_all still records the reason; apply_and_test
will report sim_unavailable (exit 12) so no false failures.
simulator  str   - preferred backend: verilator | iverilog | vcs | custom.
toolchain  [str] - external tools the recipe needs on PATH (audit / gating).
build      str   - optional build command run before 'cmd' (cwd = repo root).
cmd        str   - the test command; exit 0 == pass. Passed to apply_and_test
via --sim-cmd. If empty, apply_and_test falls back to its
make/sbt/pytest guessing chain using 'target'.
target     str   - a make target name (used when cmd is empty).
timeout    int   - per-sim wall-clock budget in seconds (default 1200).
note       str   - why runnable/blocked, and what a full setup would need.
IMAGE TOOLCHAIN (probed 2026-08-19): verilator 5.051, iverilog, make, cmake,
python3.12, pytest, riscv64-linux-gnu-gcc (LINUX, not bare-metal elf).
MISSING: sbt, scala, java, mill (=> all Chisel/SpinalHDL repos NOT runnable),
riscv64/32-unknown-elf-gcc (=> bare-metal riscv-tests binaries NOT buildable),
vcs (commercial). Set these up in the image to flip 'runnable' to true.

_default.note: No verified self-contained sim target; falls back to guessing and will usually report sim_unavailable.

openhwgroup.ariane.note: CVA6 verilator flow lives under verif/ (a FORBIDDEN path for patches) and needs riscv-tests elf binaries + a bare-metal riscv toolchain. Not runnable until riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc + the CVA6 verif sim are provisioned.

chipsalliance.rocket-chip.note: Chisel: elaboration needs sbt+JDK; running asm tests needs verilator + riscv-tests elf. Blocked (no sbt/java in image).

ucb-bar.chipyard.note: Chisel meta-repo; needs sbt+JDK+verilator+riscv toolchain and submodule init. Blocked.

riscv-boom.riscv-boom.note: Chisel core, built via chipyard. Blocked (no sbt/java).

ucb-bar.gemmini.note: Chisel accelerator, built via chipyard + gemmini-rocc-tests. Blocked.

spinalhdl.vexriscv.note: SpinalHDL: generation needs sbt/scala/JDK; regression uses verilator via sbt 'test'. Blocked (no sbt/scala/java).

vortexgpgpu.vortex.note: Verilator + a POCL/riscv-gnu toolchain. Runnable once the vortex-toolchain (riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc + libc) is installed; today only riscv64-linux-gnu-gcc exists so it is blocked.

pulp-platform.fpnew.note: FPU (CVFPU); its regression targets QuestaSim/VCS via bender+vsim. No open verilator flow packaged; blocked without a commercial simulator.

openrisc.mor1kx.note: mor1kx marocchino/monitor testbenches use iverilog but need OpenRISC (or1k) elf binaries + the mor1kx-generic tb harness under a forbidden tb/ dir. Left as guessing; likely reports sim_unavailable.

microsoft.cheriot-ibex.note: Ibex/CHERIoT lint+verilator smoke can run with verilator alone for simple cases, but full sim needs a cheriot-rtos elf and fusesoc. Uses guessing chain.

openhwgroup.cve2.note: CVE2 (ibex-derived) core; verilator lint/compile works, riscv-dv sim needs a toolchain. Uses guessing chain.

yosyshq.picorv32.note: picorv32 has a self-contained iverilog testbench (make test / test_verilog). 'test' needs riscv32-unknown-elf-gcc for firmware; 'test_verilog' still needs the compiled firmware. Runnable once a riscv32 elf gcc is present.

pulp-platform.idma.note: iDMA regression targets QuestaSim/VCS via bender. Blocked without a commercial simulator.

pulp-platform.riscv-dbg.note: Debug module tb targets QuestaSim/VCS. Blocked without a commercial simulator.

esl-epfl.x-heep.note: X-HEEP verilator flow via fusesoc + riscv32 elf toolchain. Blocked (no elf gcc/fusesoc).

jbush001.nyuziprocessor.note: Nyuzi needs its custom LLVM toolchain + emulator to build test programs. Blocked.

mister-devel.snes_mister.note: FPGA (Quartus) core with no open simulation regression. Not runnable.

chipsalliance.i3c-core.note: Uses cocotb + verilator. Runnable once cocotb is installed (cocotb-config missing today).

chipsalliance.aib-phy-hardware.note: PHY hardware; no open sim regression. Not runnable.

ipbus.ipbus-firmware.note: Xilinx/Vivado firmware; no open standalone sim. Not runnable.

sld-columbia.esp.note: ESP SoC generator targets commercial simulators / FPGA. Not runnable.
